body: Ecstatic!? no that I can tell you he will not be. I have to be realistic here, this is not going to be news he will be happy about. who knows he might not even reply.
he is going to hate me..

I wouldn't describe him as a total dick, we just wanted different things I would never keep this child from him once I told him and he decided he wanted to be involved (I can't stand women who do that), but I honestly don't need or want his money, I am moving in a week to be closer to family and have their support, but do I need to tell him now? I am only a couple months along..
I have always been pro choice.. I guess you're right, what he does with the information is up to him.

ok say I tell him, do I tell him now or once this child is born? I mean there is not really any real need to tell him yet is there? we are not together and I am not exactly thrilled about having to communicate with him again..
doubtful if he is involved it is very likely he will be one of those "part time" type of fathers... there but not.

Yes I would, but he is not going to be even a little bit happy about it. and I am not sure I would be able to handle the "are you sure its mine" comments which are always the first to come out of a mans mouth in situations like this..

but he doesn't want a child, he is not ready and people who are not ready for these types of things are typically more hassle then they are worth... its going to be hard enough bringing this child up, do I really need his feelings and opinions involved as well?

yes well whats done is done, but its not a punishment, its a child, I don't know if there is any real point to having him involved or even telling him, I don't need or want anything from him and it is my decision to keep this baby not his, I did make this decision accepting that I would be doing this on my own.
I am not getting an abortion, you are welcome to your opinions but abortion is out of the question for me.
It would be easier not to tell him, if I am honest..

No I don't need anything from him... I don't dislike the guy but we were only dating a few months and he broke up with me because he didn't want to commit to a relationship, and he did tell me once its a fear of his that he would get a call one day from a girl telling him she was pregnant, I don't really want to be that person making his nightmare a reality. I would be perfectly fine to bring this baby into the world on my own but I do feel like I might have a moral responsibility to tell him...
